extractedText: Lotte Duty Free Adds Valentino, Duvetica in Exclusive DealsNew Stores Open This Month at Myeongdong Main Branch Global Luxury Fashion Lineup ExpandedFinance|Published 2026.09.13. 10:17:05|By Kim Sun-youngearthgirl@sedaily.com|Summary|SaveAAAA view of the Maison Valentino store, which opened on the 1st at Lotte Duty Free's Myeong-dong main branch. Photo courtesy of Lotte Duty FreeLotte Duty Free has opened exclusive Maison Valentino and Duvetica stores at its Myeongdong main branch, moving to strengthen its fashion brand offerings.The company said on the 13th that it opened a store for Duvetica, an Italian premium down jacket brand, at the Myeongdong main branch on Sept. 11. It had earlier opened a store for Maison Valentino, the Italian luxury brand, on Sept. 1.The Maison Valentino store sells handbags and shoes. Signature items include a modern reinterpretation of the Rockstud pumps, first unveiled in the brand's 2010 fall-winter collection.The Duvetica store offers premium down products centered on 2026 fall-winter season arrivals. Signature items include the velvet Alloro Velvet and Torisa Velvet, the short-sleeve down Euripide, and the long down jackets Sobara and Remier.By securing both brands exclusively, Lotte Duty Free has broadened the fashion brand mix at its Myeongdong main branch. The company plans to bring in more global luxury brands to strengthen its fashion category.#LotteDutyFree#MaisonValentino#Duvetica#Myeongdong#LuxuryFashion#DutyFreeOriginal reporting by Kim Sun-young for Seoul Economic Daily.AI-translated from Korean.
